library_preparation_preflight.summary: sshd-core is self-contained for meaningful client/server coverage; its required sshd-common and SLF4J dependencies resolve transitively, and in-process SSH tests need no Docker or special properties.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Exercise the public SshClient/SshServer APIs with an in-process server, generated host keys, and temporary filesystem paths. Avoid relying on a user's ~/.ssh configuration. Add optional crypto dependencies only if testing algorithms unavailable in the default JDK providers.
risks: Native-image coverage may require explicit reachability metadata for service-loaded algorithms or key providers.
Tests involving optional Bouncy Castle, EdDSA, SFTP, or MINA backends require those modules explicitly.
